_note: Values assumed when the drawings are silent. Seeded from the author's own surveyed projects (plan2 structural drawing and workbook); confirm or edit per region and soil. Every use is flagged as an assumption in the BoQ.

width_mm.basis: convention: trench width is three times the block wall thickness (225mm wall: 675mm; 150mm wall: 450mm)

trench_depth_m.basis: plan2 survey, from ground level including topsoil

topsoil_m.basis: author's practice on plan2 and plan6

below_blockwork_m.basis: plan2 survey: footing and bed below the foundation blockwork

working_space_m.basis: author's practice, each side of excavation

block_mm.basis: drawn external wall thickness on plan2 and plan6

estimate._note: Fallbacks for when the drawings cannot be walked. Placeholders until the author confirms the rule of thumb.

internal_wall_m_per_m2_floor.basis: PLACEHOLDER: internal wall length per m2 of floor; to be confirmed by the author

trench_width_times_block.basis: convention: trench width is three times the block wall thickness (225mm wall: 675mm trench; 150mm wall: 450mm)
